events.title: Iran War Escalation

events.reasoning: The escalating conflict between the US and Iran has the potential to disrupt global energy markets, leading to increased volatility in the oil sector. However, the broader market may also be affected, with the S&P 500 potentially benefiting from safe-haven flows.
